instruction: How many unique songs are there across my Spotify song library, albums library and all playlists?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so the goal only demands that the three Spotify collections (song library, album library, playlist library) have been inspected and the task completed. The answer object unique-song-count is a runtime value: the size of the union of song ids from the song library (song_id field), every album's song_ids and every playlist's song_ids; it is passed as the answer parameter of supervisor-complete-task. Each show-* action stands for a fully paginated retrieval (iterate page_index from 0 until an empty page is returned); page_index is optional so the call is executable without it. The username is obtained from supervisor.show_profile (modeled by profile-known plus the static username-for fact), analogous to the password-for convention.
